If not found, create supplier with name Stormberg AS, organization number 908782003, address Parkveien 55, 8006 Bodø, and bank account 81867612726
Validate account 6500 exists and is allowed for supplier invoice posting
Create/register supplier invoice for supplier Stormberg AS with invoice number INV-2026-5859, invoice date 2026-01-11, due date 2026-02-10, and total 38562
Add supplier invoice line with description Kontorrekvista, amount excluding VAT 30850, account 6500, VAT rate 25%
Set incoming VAT amount to 7712 using correct Tripletex VAT code for inngående MVA 25%
Verify booked gross amount equals 38562 and save the supplier invoice

planned_endpoints.summary: Create supplier. Related supplier addresses may also be created.
Find accounts corresponding with sent data.
Add new voucher. IMPORTANT: Also creates postings. Only the gross amounts will be used. Amounts should be rounded to 2 decimals.

rules: When email is provided, ALWAYS set BOTH email AND invoiceEmail to the same value.
ALWAYS include phoneNumber if provided in the prompt — scoring checks phone.
ALWAYS include postalAddress with addressLine1, postalCode, city, country={id: 161} when address info is provided.
Use params={"number": XXXX} to resolve a specific account number to its ID.
This is a QUERY PARAM via the params field — NOT json_body.
Do NOT use /ledger/accountingPeriod — it does not exist.
ALWAYS set BOTH amountGross AND amountGrossCurrency to the SAME value on every posting.
Do NOT include postings with row=0 — row 0 is system-generated and will cause a 422.
AUTO-SPLIT RULES: ONLY vatType id=3 (25% utgående) triggers auto-split. vatType id=1 does NOT auto-split.
For supplier costs: use vatType=3 (NOT id=1) with ONLY the debit posting. Tripletex detects the expense account and applies inngående MVA automatically.
For vatType=0: include BOTH debit AND credit postings manually. They must sum to 0.
If you get 422 'postings don't sum to 0': switch to vatType=3 with single debit posting, OR add both debit+credit with vatType=0.
NEVER use vatType=1 — it does NOT auto-generate balancing entries and will always cause 422 with single posting.
Do NOT include currency on postings — let it default. Including currency={} causes 'factor must be >= 1' error.
For supplier invoices, set supplier={"id": supplier_id} on the debit posting.
Resolve account numbers: GET /ledger/account with params={"number": XXXX}, then use account={"id": resolved_id}. NEVER use account={"number": XXXX} in postings.

payload.question:
I need to register a supplier invoice via POST /ledger/voucher. The expense account 6500 has legalVatTypes that include id=1 but NOT id=3. The field rules say vatType=1 does NOT auto-split. 

The invoice details: gross total 38562 NOK, net 30850, VAT 7712 (25%). Account 6500 for the expense, supplier already created.

payload.headline: Voucher created but 5/6 scoring checks failed — likely wrong amounts, vatType, or posting structure
what_went_wrong: Agent used vatType id=1 on account 6500 and manually posted account 2710 for VAT — but the correct approach for inngående MVA 25% on supplier invoices likely requires vatType id=3 or a different vatType code, causing wrong VAT handling.

The net/gross split is wrong: agent posted 30850 net + 7712 VAT = 38562, but the invoice total is 38562 incl. VAT, so net should be 30849.60 and VAT 7712.40 — rounding or calculation error may have caused check failures.
The supplier posting on account 2400 may be missing required fields (e.g., dueDate, invoiceNumber on the posting itself, or the supplier reference placed on wrong posting line).
The GET /ledger/account calls were made without filtering by account number (missing ?number=XXXX param), making them inefficient and potentially returning wrong account IDs if not properly filtered.
what_worked: Supplier Stormberg AS was created successfully with correct org number, address, and bank account.
Voucher POST succeeded (HTTP 200) and a voucher ID was returned.
what_to_try_next: Use the correct vatType for inngående MVA 25% on supplier invoices — check which vatType id maps to INPUT_VAT_25 in the Tripletex environment, likely id=3 or id=5, not id=1.
Add dueDate field to the voucher and ensure the creditor posting on account 2400 includes the supplier reference AND the invoice due date (2026-02-10) as required by supplier invoice checks.
Filter GET /ledger/account calls with ?number=6500, ?number=2710, ?number=2400 to avoid fetching all accounts and to ensure correct account IDs are resolved.
unnecessary_calls: GET /ledger/account (unfiltered, first call) — should use ?number=6500 to get only the needed account
